newsitem.title: INDIA: India retains import curbs on consumer electronics.
newsitem.headline: India retains import curbs on consumer electronics.

text.p: India's Commerce Ministry, said on Monday that under its export promotion capital goods (EPCG) scheme, the threshold limit for zero-duty imports has been reduced to 50 million rupees for agricultural and allied sectors from 200 million rupees.

"Export-oriented units/export processing zones in agriculture and allied sectors can now sell 50 percent of their output in the domestic tariff area (DTA) on payment of duty without stipulation of any value-addition condition," the ministry said in a statement unveiling a five-year export-import policy.
